name: Biotechnology Research Innovation And Entrepreneurship Development (Bio-RIDE)
benefit:
- The scheme has a total proposed financial outlay of ₹91,97,00,00,000/- for the period spanning from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
- Startups receive seed funding, incubation support, and dedicated mentorship to nurture a thriving ecosystem for bio-entrepreneurs.
- Researchers, institutions, and universities receive extramural funding and direct grants for cutting-edge research and development in modern bi
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a legal entity, either for-profit or not-for-profit. - The applicant must be officially registered in India with the respective taxation and other administrative authorities. - The applicant must have tangible prior experience in the applied functional area of bio-services or biomanufacturing. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any Central Government. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any State Government. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any Public Sector Undertaking of the Government of India. - The applicant must ensure that major promoters or the legal entity are not involved in any major litigation that may impact the delivery of assigned projects. - The applicant must strictly adhere to the data protection, confidentiality, and conflict of interest policies laid down by the Department of Biotechnology and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council. - The applicant, if applying as a startup, small and medium enterprise, or industry, must have a minimum of 51% of its stake owned and controlled by resident Indian citizens. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** - The applicant should preferably demonstrate proven expertise, operational experience, and access to pre-existing infrastructure. - The applicant should ideally have already secured the necessary regulatory clearances for their innovation or be close to obtaining them.
